   - **AIS/TIS details** (download from e-Filing portal)
   - Any other income proof (rental income, etc., if applicable)

   - Sign in using your credentials

   - Select **Assessment Year** (the relevant year)
   - Choose **ITR-2**
   - Click **“File Now”**

     - **Income from Salary** (if you have Form 16)

   - Submit the return on the portal.
